name: Tormarchy
author: TripleU613
description: Route all system traffic through Tor from the Omarchy bar, with a real kill switch, new circuits, and exit-country selection.

barWidget.description: Toggle system-wide Tor, request a new circuit, pick an exit country, and test circuit speed.

schema.label: Default mode
schema.description: lan: all WAN through Tor, local network still reachable. strict: local network dropped too. socks: no system-wide change, apps opt in to the SOCKS proxy on 9050.

schema.label: Latency interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-time the circuit while the panel is open. Measurements share one persistent connection, so each is a single round trip. Never runs while the panel is closed.
